issue_title: Response.elapsed not set when using mock transport
issue_body: When using a MockTransport in tests, response.elapsed is None instead of a timedelta. Expected: a zero or near-zero timedelta. Steps: see linked test.

issue_title: Markup escaping fails with nested brackets
issue_body: When markup string contains nested [ ] characters, escape=True does not fully escape the inner brackets, causing a MarkupError on render.

issue_title: Default value not shown in --help when type is Optional[Path]
issue_body: When a CLI argument has type Optional[Path] and a default, the --help output does not show the default value. Expected: [default: path/to/default].

issue_title: model_validator(mode='before') receives raw dict even when input is a model instance
issue_body: When passing an already-validated model instance to a model with a before validator, the validator receives the raw __dict__ instead of the model instance. This breaks isinstance checks inside validators.

issue_title: HTTPException detail not included in 422 response when raised in dependency
issue_body: When raising HTTPException(422, detail='custom') inside a Depends function, the response body does not include the custom detail — only the default 422 schema is returned.
